notes.topic: ci gates must fail not skip
notes.correction: A CI gate that cannot resolve inputs must fail loudly, not skip; test the consumer of the verdict and read real step output once.
notes.repeat_signal: reproduced it anyway one step below

notes.topic: verify shared dependencies before deleting directory
notes.correction: Before deleting a directory named for a retiring thing, grep each file across other repos and read each candidate's own purpose statement; don't trust prior analysis.
notes.repeat_signal: The same collision cut the other way

notes.topic: prove added guards are not inert
notes.correction: When a diff adds a guard or test, revert the fix and confirm it goes red; keep an adversarial reviewer slot; self-review is not enough.

notes.topic: delete test fixtures must pass other predicates
notes.correction: For multi-predicate destructive finds, plant negatives that pass every other predicate (e.g. aged files), and mutation-test each predicate; pin threshold values.

notes.topic: git-guard bypass does not satisfy dcg
notes.correction: ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GIT=1 does not clear dcg; get explicit approval or use wt-sweep.sh for branch deletion, and use the Write tool for dynamic-path files.
Phrase human-only exceptions as a decision or credential to ask for plus the agent's next action, never a step to 'name'; re-measure exact shipped wording.

notes.topic: negative tests must assert precondition reached
notes.correction: Fail-closed tests must assert execution reached the branch under test; build fixtures with production writers and grep tests when removing registry entries.
Before calling an autonomous PR workstream complete, re-check gates executed, mutation runs valid, planted negatives can fail, and reviews were independent.
After arming auto-merge, put follow-ups in a new PR or disarm first; verify the merge commit contains your last commit.
Keep ${var:-default} fallbacks apostrophe-free inside case arms; don't trust bash -n line numbers, isolate with a minimal repro.
Digits-only checks are unsafe for bash arithmetic; range-check by digit count, then normalise with 10# at the single validation loop.
When adding a field to a bash read-parsed record, update every reader and writer in one change and add a round-trip test.

notes.topic: launcher functions use subshell and command
notes.correction: New .bashrc launcher functions should run in a subshell and invoke the target via `command <name>`, not copy mkcd's cd-the-caller pattern.

notes.topic: mock SITES root in bashrc tests
notes.correction: Tests for the cad planted-negative must fixture a temporary HOME/SITES rather than rely on real environment; establish the first .bashrc test precedent.

notes.topic: size the pty when testing shells
notes.correction: Drive interactive shell tests via a pty with winsize set, feed stdin to bash -i, and mark runs INVALID if ble.sh errors appear.
notes.repeat_signal: two confidently-reported false root causes in one session

notes.topic: kernel bounds over sweepers for memory
notes.correction: For memory pressure, use cgroup MemoryHigh/MemoryMax bounds and lifecycle coupling, gate watchdogs on PSI, don't offer restarts or another sweeper as the fix.
Check cass source_paths exist before trusting results; mark unresolvable signals unknown, never absent or present; prefer git/gh/filesystem anchors.
Route ce-ideate stages that write dossier files to general-purpose sonnet; reserve lean-reader for read-and-return stages.
Check .git/lost-found before git gc; surface rescue markers as an operator decision, and create real refs to rescue objects first.

notes.topic: check live machine not just artifacts
notes.correction: Prefer runtime sweeps over allowlists; ask what the live equivalent of a repo-file check is, and report failure age.
For timeout or ceiling detectors, test zero-disabled override, exit-code propagation under pipefail, and the true timer start point.
Preserve claude-loop's empty-delivery check as a standalone gate rather than enumerating kill reasons reactively.

notes.topic: merge is not deploy; pull yourself
notes.correction: After merging symlinked-dir changes, verify the symlink target yourself and fast-forward via ExitWorktree keep; re-check before telling anyone to run commands.
notes.enforcer_named: SessionStart hook fast-forwards a clean parked main checkout

notes.topic: read tests before reviving closed work
notes.correction: Before reviving apparently abandoned fixes, read the test assertions; a closed PR may encode a deliberate decision. Verify recommendations against current source.

notes.topic: verify codex outcome not pipeline status
notes.correction: Don't pipe load-bearing codex exec into tail/tee without pipefail or PIPESTATUS; verify worktree status and classify quota errors separately.
Claude-demoted skill forks must carry agents/openai.yaml with allow_implicit_invocation false for Codex; verify identity before deleting untracked blockers.

notes.topic: land unmerged live work not track it
notes.correction: When a backup diff references untracked paths, check open own PRs first instead of adding the path to sync; remove staging copies.

notes.topic: audit secrets by digest not value
notes.correction: Audit credentials by extracting names only and comparing truncated sha256 digests; report distinct counts and reused values, then shred scratch.
If dcg flags plain git -C $VAR with git-alias-semantic-unverified, resolve or quote the variable; fixed upstream as of v0.14.4.
If dcg blocks gh --body-file heredocs or dynamic redirects, use Write-tool temp files or stdin heredocs; historical, fixed upstream.

notes.topic: never launder around dcg heredoc blocks
notes.correction: When dcg blocks a legitimate heredoc script, author the file with the Write tool and isolate destructive steps in a reviewable script, not reshape commands.
Never hand-copy reviewer findings; generate compact returns from on-disk artifacts with a projection script and pass later stages file paths.
Check the property that matters, not its proxy invariant; verify tool output against the source of truth and mutation-check regression tests.
Review destructive find scripts for symlinked roots, traversal races, near-threshold fixtures, and asserted reported totals.
When a PR shows no checks, read mergeStateStatus first; DIRTY means resolve the conflict, and merge main before pushing long-running branches.
Confirm dispatcher-ledger.sh audit-correction refuses to flip broken runs to kept or waste when no ended row exists.

notes.topic: state sample size with safety claims
notes.correction: Don't claim fleet-wide safety from a small sample; state the fraction checked in the same sentence or check the whole population.
In status updates state only what you just checked; say 'expected to be doing X, not yet confirmed' for unverified intended behaviour.
Before replacing a deployed key that differs from canonical, check if it is deliberately scoped and working; fix only documentation.
If a pipeline stage silently switches models, check for model_refusal_fallback with apiRefusalCategory cyber before assuming a bug; account usage accordingly.

notes.topic: gates must have a reachable pass
notes.correction: After building an opt-in verification, run it against the real artifact and confirm it reports a pass; ensure producer and consumer agree on layout.
Check what environment runs a fail-closed guard unattended; read dotup status before trusting currency; use %h in unit PATH.

notes.topic: never hand back commands to operator
notes.correction: The agent runs every command itself (pull, start servers, generate files) and hands Will only a URL, result, or judgment call.
notes.repeat_signal: why do you keep making me run those commands?

notes.correction: Ship the smallest running-agent edit first; build fixtures, gates, governance only when a consumer exists; run process-porn worksheet before presenting plans.

notes.topic: check git status before launchpad pull
notes.correction: Run git status --short before any git pull in a ~/SITES launchpad; if dirty don't pull, move dirt to a rescue branch, never reset --hard.
Ask what single command settles it before spawning agents; cap corroboration fleets at about 5; never declare workflows done from a poll loop.
Run all mechanics yourself, hand back only genuine decisions in plain language; use native tools over handrolled scripts; no operational run-this lines.
